evidence: The existing prose workflow is the behavior to replace or demote behind an enforced wrapper.

The Cartographer extension currently registers tools and can host the wrapper tool plus harness lifecycle hooks.

Extension tool registration tests should cover the new wrapper tool and guardrail outputs.
Workflow docs tests should assert wrapper-first guidance and no prose-only enforcement claims.
Wrapper should call planning graph validation to detect pending phases and receipt/context gaps.
Wrapper should continue appending deterministic validation receipts for checks it orchestrates.
ADR-0004 chose single-writer state, but the observed session shows enforcement needs a wrapper/harness layer.
Wrapper must preserve deterministic validation and read-only auditor principles.
User-facing docs should describe the command/tool wrapper as the normal implement entrypoint.
Stable agent instructions should forbid bypassing the wrapper for normal implement workflows once shipped.
Pi extensions expose commands, tools, event interception, context injection, compaction hooks, and session persistence.

Pi transcript compaction and Cartographer compact-generate are distinct mechanisms that must be bridged intentionally.
Session analysis provides the failure mode motivating wrapper enforcement.
